d: Officers uncover a smuggling effort at the mail centre, two passengers from Taiwan are caught lying and packages of undeclared kava raise officers' suspicions.

A supermarket is robbed by a staff member who not only clears out the cash machine, she also invites her friends round to shop for free. Also, wild boars escape when a farm is burgled late at night. When the thieves are caught, the police make a gruesome discovery.

A ski centre is repeatedly robbed by a sweet-toothed thief, but a policeman uses his trainer prints and CCTV to catch him out, plus a burglar takes too long when trying to steal from a laptop repair shop.
Two jewellers in London are victims of an armed robber, but he soon ends up a fugitive in a high-speed car chase, and three fly-tippers are caught in the act because they make rubbish mistakes.

On rocky islands off the coast of South Africa, thousands of creatures congregate to breed. Among these, huge colonies of cape gannets dominate. Surrounded by rich waters, they can find enough to feed themselves and their young.

The Eastern Cape Province is investing heavily in ecotourism and conservation as an alternative to fishing and commercial development. The region is reclaiming farmlands and closing fishing grounds for wildlife. This is one of the most exciting conservation success stories in Africa.
